D35.title: an RWA subject may NEVER render SOLID — the verdict is STRUCTURALLY CAPPED at CAUTION/UNVERIFIED because the collateral settles off-chain and nothing on-chain can verify it; the cap renders as a REASON, not a shrug

D35.signingConsequence: SIGN → the structural cap is INSTALLED (an RWA subject can no longer render SOLID; the verdict is capped with its reason). Until then, RWA renders the WARNING + its SAMPLE-labeled attestation surface, with NO cap applied — because a cap is a verdict-shaped rule and AN AGENT MAY NOT INSTALL A VERDICT RULE (the D27/D29/D30 precedent). The truth about the opacity is told immediately either way. Softening the cap because a subject 'looks fine on-chain' is a Halt — looking fine on-chain is precisely what RWA cannot prove.
